# Nutrimotion Jamaica

Nutrimotion Jamaica is a premium meal prep and personal training service located in Kingston, Jamaica.
We provide science-backed structured nutrition, habit coaching, and fitness training to help users achieve their body goals.

## Services
- **Premium Meal Prep**: Fresh, macro-calculated meals delivered across Kingston and St. Andrew.
- **Personal Training**: Expert coaching with customized workout routines and certified professionals.
- **Books & Education**: Guides on fat loss, mobility, recovery, and strength training nutrition.

## Technical Details
This application is built using:
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router)
- **UI Library**: Material UI (MUI v7)
- **Authentication**: Auth0
- **Database**: MongoDB via Mongoose

## Important URLs
- **Main Website**: [https://www.nutrimotionjamaica.com](https://www.nutrimotionjamaica.com)
- **Training**: [https://www.nutrimotionjamaica.com/training](https://www.nutrimotionjamaica.com/training)
- **Meals**: [https://www.nutrimotionjamaica.com/meals](https://www.nutrimotionjamaica.com/meals)

## SEO & Accessibility
Nutrimotion is fully optimized with JSON-LD structured data (HealthAndBeautyBusiness, FAQPage) for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Local SEO.
